name: Will Hardie
title: Communication strategist, advisor and executive coach
bio_short: Communication strategist and executive coach with more than 25 years' experience across 50 countries. Oxford psychologist and former Reuters foreign correspondent. One of the world's leading advisors on executive communication.
bio: Will is a communication strategist, advisor and executive coach with more than 25 years' experience working across 50 countries. He studied experimental psychology at Oxford and later journalism and politics in the United States before joining Reuters as a graduate trainee, where he took foreign postings in Brussels, Stockholm and Belgrade covering international summits, financial markets and political affairs.  Will co-founded a global communications consultancy and later established ISOC as a specialist training institution. For six years he served as chief advisor to the head of government communications in the office of a Prime Minister, and has since counselled hundreds of cabinet ministers, CEOs and senior executives across Europe, North America, the Middle East, Africa and Asia. His clients include national governments, Fortune 500 companies, central banks and international institutions.  At ISOC, Will leads programmes in executive presence, media training, crisis communication and strategic messaging. His background in psychology gives his coaching a distinctive analytical depth, helping senior leaders understand how communication works under pressure and how to adapt their approach to different audiences and situations. Will is based in London and Dubai and trains in English and French. He is recognised as one of the world's leading advisors on executive communication.

For six years he served as chief advisor to the head of government communications in the office of a Prime Minister, directing large-scale communication strategy projects for national governments and major corporations. He has counselled hundreds of cabinet ministers, senior politicians, CEOs and senior executives across Europe, North America, the Middle East, Africa and Asia. His clients span government, energy, financial services, aviation, defence, healthcare and technology sectors.  At ISOC, Will leads programmes in executive presence, media training, crisis communication and strategic messaging. His background in psychology gives his coaching a distinctive analytical depth, helping senior leaders understand how communication works under pressure and how to adapt their approach to different audiences, media formats and high-stakes situations. He has written crisis plans and positioning for global top-500 companies and led long-term projects to build communication strategies and systems for federal and national governments. Will is based in London and Dubai and trains in English and French. He is recognised as one of the world's leading advisors on executive communication.
